sn7.16:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Paccanīkasāto nāma brāhmaṇo Sāvatthiyaṃ pativasati || || 3.
sn7.16:1.3: Atha kho Paccanīkasātassa brāhmaṇassa etad ahosi || || Yaṃ
sn7.16:1.5: yaṃ yad eva samaṇo Gotamo bhāsissati || taṃ tad ev-assāhaṃ paccanīkassan ti || || 4.
sn7.16:1.6: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā ajjhokāse caṅkamati || || 5.
sn7.16:1.7: Atha kho Paccanīkasāto brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam caṅkamantam anucaṅkamamāno Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.16:4.1: Evaṃ vutte Paccanīkasāto brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.16:4.3: Upāsakam mam bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti || || 1.
